facts.value: To avoid complications or delays with the STEM OPT Extension application, ISSC recommends that you do not travel or change employers while your STEM OPT Extension application is pending.

metadata.chunk_title: Changing Employer while STEM application is pending (and Post-OPT still active)

facts.value: If a change in employment is unavoidable, you must complete the following: Log into your SEVP Portal account and update your current Post-OPT employment; Correct your current employer’s end date; Input your new employer’s information.

metadata.chunk_title: Changing Employer while STEM application is pending (and Post-OPT still active)

facts.value: Submit a form I-983 for the new STEM employer.

metadata.chunk_title: Changing Employer while STEM application is pending (and Post-OPT still active)

facts.value: Go to the MyISSC eForm Portal, click on F-1 STEM OPT on the left side bar and choose the STEM OPT Employment Update eForm.

metadata.chunk_title: Changing Employer while STEM application is pending (and Post-OPT still active)

facts.value: For the question 'Is your STEM Extension application still pending with USCIS?' make sure to select 'yes' and then choose the option of 'Change to a new job – STEM OPT still pending' and complete and submit the eForm.

metadata.chunk_title: Changing Employer while STEM application is pending (and Post-OPT still active)

facts.value: Your SEVIS record will be updated to reflect the reported changes and an updated I-20 will be issued.

metadata.chunk_title: Changing Employer while STEM application is pending (and Post-OPT still active)

facts.value: To update USCIS with your change in employment, upload your new I-20 in the Unsolicited Evidence section of your STEM OPT application in the USCIS portal.

metadata.chunk_title: Changing Employer while STEM application is pending (and Post-OPT still active)

facts.value: Do not travel or change employers while your STEM OPT Extension application is pending.

metadata.chunk_title: Changing Employer while STEM application is pending (and Post-OPT ended) + Regulations during STEM OPT

facts.value: Submit form I-983 for the new STEM employer and complete the STEM OPT Employment Update eForm.

metadata.chunk_title: Changing Employer while STEM application is pending (and Post-OPT ended) + Regulations during STEM OPT

facts.value: Go to the MyISSC eForm Portal, click on F-1 STEM OPT, choose the STEM OPT Employment Update eForm, and select 'yes' for the question about your STEM Extension application and choose 'Change to a new job – STEM OPT still pending'.

metadata.chunk_title: Changing Employer while STEM application is pending (and Post-OPT ended) + Regulations during STEM OPT

facts.value: Upload your new I-20 in the Unsolicited Evidence section of your STEM OPT application in the USCIS portal along with a cover letter that includes information about your change in employment and the E-Verify number of your new employer.

metadata.chunk_title: Changing Employer while STEM application is pending (and Post-OPT ended) + Regulations during STEM OPT

facts.value: You are still in F-1 immigration status and must follow regulations to maintain your status.

metadata.chunk_title: Changing Employer while STEM application is pending (and Post-OPT ended) + Regulations during STEM OPT

facts.value: Upload a copy of your STEM OPT EAD card in the MyISSC eForm portal after receiving it.

metadata.chunk_title: Changing Employer while STEM application is pending (and Post-OPT ended) + Regulations during STEM OPT

facts.value: While on STEM OPT, you are required to do reporting every 6 months to maintain your F-1 status.

metadata.chunk_title: 6, 12, 18, and 24-month Reporting

facts.value: 6 months, 12 months, 18 months, 24 months

metadata.chunk_title: 6, 12, 18, and 24-month Reporting

facts.value: Submit the 6-month reporting eForm to confirm that your employment information is up to date.

metadata.chunk_title: 6, 12, 18, and 24-month Reporting

facts.value: Submit the 12-month reporting eForm to confirm that your employment information is up to date AND upload the I-983 Pg. 5 Self-Evaluation.

metadata.chunk_title: 6, 12, 18, and 24-month Reporting

facts.value: Submit the 18-month reporting eForm to confirm that your employment information is up to date.

metadata.chunk_title: 6, 12, 18, and 24-month Reporting

facts.value: Submit the 24-month reporting eForm to confirm that your employment information is up to date AND upload the I-983 Pg. 5 Final Evaluation.

metadata.chunk_title: 6, 12, 18, and 24-month Reporting

facts.value: You can submit each report up to 30 days before your 6-month deadline.

metadata.chunk_title: 6, 12, 18, and 24-month Reporting

facts.value: Do not call or email the office for reporting; submit through the MyISSC eForm portal.

metadata.chunk_title: 6, 12, 18, and 24-month Reporting

facts.value: For more details on the reporting requirements, refer to the STEM OPT Validation Reporting Homebase Course.

facts.value: While on STEM OPT, you are limited in the information that you can update in the SEVP Portal. Employment updates must be submitted through the STEM OPT Employment Update eForm in the MyISSC eForm portal.

metadata.chunk_title: Updates in Employment Information + Multiple employers
